fairplay_gateway.label: FairPlay Gateway URL
fairplay_gateway.description: Address of the FairPlay engine, for example https://127.0.0.1:20025. When Music Assistant and the engine use host networking, use the loopback address.

fairplay_token.label: FairPlay API Token
fairplay_token.description: Token shared with the FairPlay engine. It must match ADAM_API_TOKEN on the engine service.

cache_enabled.label: Enable track cache
cache_enabled.description: Store decrypted lossless tracks on disk so replaying them does not create a new FairPlay playback session. Turning it off removes already cached tracks.

cache_max_size_mb.label: Track cache size (MB)
cache_max_size_mb.description: Maximum disk space used by cached tracks. Least recently played tracks are removed first. Set to 0 to disable the cache and remove cached tracks.

cache_dir.label: Track cache directory
cache_dir.description: Optional directory for cached tracks. Leave empty to use the Music Assistant data/cache directory. The provider instance id is appended automatically.

fairplay.title: Configure the FairPlay engine
fairplay.description: Enter the address and API token of the FairPlay engine. These values are saved with this provider.

app_token.title: Enter a developer token
app_token.description: The bundled Apple Music developer token is unavailable or expired. Paste a valid MusicKit developer token to continue.

user.title: Sign in to Apple Music
user.description: Continue to sign in with your Apple ID in a browser window. Advanced users can instead paste a Music User Token, for example for child accounts where the browser sign-in is unavailable.

auth.title: Authorize Music Assistant
auth.description: Sign in with your Apple ID in the window that opens to grant Music Assistant access.

abort.auth_cancelled: Sign-in was cancelled or timed out before Apple returned a token. Please try again.

manifest.description: Stream Apple Music’s full catalogue and playlists.
